name: Check that cannot match or pass
definition: A criterion embeds a command, pattern or test selector whose literal form cannot match or cannot pass against the text or state the same plan orders.
question_template: Apply the criterion's literal pattern to the text this task orders. Does it pass on that text? Do not use the current file as evidence; it may already contain the finished work.
severity_guidance: Blocking when the check can never pass, or can never fail, on the text the document orders; minor when it only reads poorly.
known_weakness: Commands with computed patterns; regular expressions that Python and POSIX read differently.
